newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daito Trust up on TSE on buying back.
newsitem.headline: Daito Trust up on TSE on buying back.

text.p: Shares of Daito Trust Construction Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Monday afternoon in an overall market trend of buying back domestic demand-related shares.
Daito Trust was up 180 yen, or 17.48 percent, at 1,210 by 0516 GMT.
The issue was the second largest percentage gainer.
Daito Trust constructs and leases building.
"Overall share prices are stabilising and the move to buy back shares, especially domestic demand-related shares, has become active," an official at a medium-sized securities house said.

"Shares of Daito Trust were sold as part of the broad selling of domestic demand-related shares. But as the market has started to show signs of recovery, a move to buy back the company's shares has emerged," a trader at a major brokerage said.
